name: Dirty Texts: Are You Sure?
source:
In "Are You Sure?" you play the role of a husband who, wanting to spice up their sex, convinced his wife to try a one week open marriage adventure. After all, it's not cheating if you both agree. During this week you and your wife will test different things and see if this will improve your relationship or destroy it.

[From F95Zone]
